classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding sides using vertex symbols in differently oriented triangles, then solve a proportion.

content.prompt: Determine the value of the pronumeral. Careful, as these triangles are not oriented the same.

spec.description: Small upright triangle above and left of a larger inverted triangle. Filled square, circle and triangle symbols identify corresponding vertices; they are correspondence symbols, not right-angle assertions. Ordinary source pink and teal strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Small square–circle side 2 cm, square–triangle side 3 cm, circle–triangle side 4 cm. Large circle–square side 8 cm and circle–triangle side y.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown y remains uncompleted; supplied answer omitted.

spec.description: Two differently oriented triangles paired left and right, retaining circle, square and triangle correspondence markers. Ordinary outlines and labels use black.
spec.mathematics: Left triangle–circle 3 cm, circle–square 2 cm, square–triangle 4 cm. Right triangle–square 6 cm and circle–triangle z.

spec.description: Left triangle points up and right; right triangle points down and right. All three correspondence markers and relative orientations retained; ordinary strokes black.
spec.mathematics: Left square–circle 6 cm, square–triangle 8 cm, circle–triangle 12 cm. Right square–triangle 12 cm and circle–triangle w.

spec.description: Two upright triangles with reversed left/right correspondence. Preserve square at each apex, and reversed circle and triangle base markers. Ordinary strokes black.
spec.mathematics: Small triangle–square 4 cm, square–circle 5 cm, triangle–circle 6 cm. Large circle–square 20 cm and square–triangle z.

spec.description: Larger triangle at left and smaller rotated triangle at right, with circle, square and cross correspondence symbols. Ordinary strokes black.
spec.mathematics: Left circle–cross v and square–cross 15 cm. Right cross–square 10 cm, cross–circle 8 cm and square–circle 9 cm.

spec.description: Large oblique triangle at left and narrow vertical triangle at right, preserving cross, square and triangle correspondence symbols. Ordinary strokes black.
spec.mathematics: Left cross–square y and square–triangle 18 cm. Right cross–triangle 9 cm, triangle–square 8 cm and cross–square 15 cm.

spec.description: Bow-tie pair sharing one central vertex. Both diagonals continue through that vertex. Cross and circle markers reverse vertically between triangles; triangle markers lie on opposite sides of the shared vertex. Ordinary strokes black.
spec.mathematics: Left cross–circle 7 cm, cross–centre 5 cm and circle–centre 6 cm. Right centre–cross 12 cm and circle–cross h.

spec.description: Small upper-left triangle and larger lower-right triangle share a vertex. Horizontal sides are collinear and the diagonal continues through the shared vertex. Filled squares remain correspondence symbols. Ordinary strokes black; no right-angle assertions added.
spec.mathematics: Small cross–square z and square–circle 4 cm. Large circle–square 10 cm, square–cross 12 cm and circle–cross 15 cm. All source measurements retained.
